body:
A Decomposer can otherwise turn two alternative approaches into Claims and make both required by the parent. Its shared brief now selects one search route, adds only that route's necessary premises, and preserves alternatives as notes and existing progress records. The constraint applies to standalone and Pursue turns.

The Verifier now reads the final proof and key-ideas summary together for omitted assumptions, changes to quantifiers or scope, and hidden Conditional support. Tool permissions, write scopes, commands, the run state machine, and researcher Acceptance remain unchanged.

Validation: Standards and Spec audits passed with no findings; all 10 role/Pursue contexts retained identical Claude/Codex arguments and command sheets; full agents suite passed (199 tests). No model trial was run.

Related glossary: DengZhiyuan-math/proof-cli#211.
title: fix: clarify Decomposer routes and Verifier final-proof checks

T8 gap 1 (proof-cli#197). The Reader turn that proof-web runs reported a lapsed Claude login as "the Reader's turn failed: success". Claude Code ends that turn with is_error, subtype "success", exit 1 and no stderr; the reason is only in the turn's text (reproduced with an empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). `_failure_reason` (#179) already reads it for a run's turns; it is now public as `failure_reason` for proof-web to use.

Tests: 200 passed, one new.

body:
This is prism-local's 245a535, "Choose the Claude Code profile folder", made a project setting. It is the proof-agents half of a take into proof-cli's latex-agent (DengZhiyuan-math/proof-cli, `feat/take-prism-37de720`).

`[studio] claude_config_dir = "~/.claude-work"` in proof.toml sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, with `~` expanded, in the environment of every agent turn of the project:
- **Who uses it:** a run's roles, the researcher's Ask, and the map's agent.
- **When it is unset or blank:** the server's own environment stands, as before.

The setting is per project because one page server serves several projects. A server started from a shell without the variable was #132 tier 1's first failure: all five Starts ended "Not logged in".

The latex-agent half makes the studio's account check, command list and usage probe use the same environment.

Tests: one new test covers the node agent's env, the Ask's, the map agent's, `~` expansion and a blank value. Full suite: 101 passed.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
